lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical line segments visible with roughly equidistant spacing across the mid-torso to the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation identified on the fourth vertical line segment counting from the posterior edge, with the split occurring in the upper third of the torso height.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Second and third lines from the posterior terminate mid-mass; fifth and sixth lines exhibit dashed fragmentation near the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast circular spots positioned vertically on the posterior upper haunch area.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Curvilinear lyrate trajectory with a posterior-dorsal orientation; initial upward vector from the frontal bone followed by a lateral and then medial inward turn.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: 0.85:1 estimated ratio of the distance between the two terminal tips relative to the combined width of the horn bases in 2D projection.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 18% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the cheek region; white chevron marking on the bridge of the nose; bright white ventral throat patch; white transverse banding on the distal portion of the limbs.
